 def parse_request_value(raw):

behavioral_claims: parse_request_value no longer executes arbitrary code; it parses input as JSON via json.loads
Malicious expressions such as __import__('os').system('id') now raise json.JSONDecodeError instead of executing
Valid JSON inputs (42, [1, 2], "hello") continue to return the same values as before
Malformed or non-JSON input raises json.JSONDecodeError (a subclass of ValueError) rather than SyntaxError/NameError
